column1: # Corrections to Tatoeba sentences, applied whenever the examples and the cloze
# One line per sentence, four columns separated by tabs:
#   id       the Tatoeba id of the Ukrainian sentence
#   uk       the sentence as it should read, or - to leave the sentence out
#   en       a new English translation, or empty to keep Tatoeba's
#   source   who pointed it out, and when
# A corrected sentence keeps its id, so the site still links to the original,
# and is credited as "adapted": CC BY 2.0 FR asks that changes be indicated.
